subject: Problem reading the CDF group names during the plm

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Problem reading the CDF group names during the plm
parts:
Hi,

the error occurs while trying to create the so called monocell CDF.
This is only done ones per CDF, so as soon as it is created, this will
not a problem anymore. Let's try to figure out what is going on in
your case. I could be as simple as a broken CDF.

Try this in a fresh R session (without loading any saved images, scripts etc):

> library(aroma.affymetrix);
> verbose <- Verbose(threshold=-20); timestampOn(verbose);
> cdf <- AffymetrixCdfFile$fromChipType("Mapping250K_Nsp");
> print(cdf);
AffymetrixCdfFile:
Path: C:/Documents and Settings/hb/My Documents/My Data/annotationData/chipTypes

/Mapping250K_Nsp
Filename: Mapping250K_Nsp.cdf
Filesize: 185.45MB
File format: v4 (binary; XDA)
Chip type: Mapping250K_Nsp
Dimension: 2560x2560
Number of cells: 6553600
Number of units: 262338
Cells per unit: 24.98
Number of QC units: 6
RAM: 0.00MB

> getFileSize(cdf)
[1] 194455495
> str(getUnitNames(cdf));
chr [1:262338] "AFFX-5Q-123" "AFFX-5Q-456" "AFFX-5Q-789" ...
> cdfM <- getMonocellCdf(cdf, verbose=verbose);
# This will take quite some time (have a coffee)
...
> print(cdfM);
AffymetrixCdfFile:
Path: C:/Documents and Settings/hb/My Documents/My Data/annotationData/chipTypes
/Mapping250K_Nsp
Filename: Mapping250K_Nsp,monocell.cdf
Filesize: 112.57MB

Chip type: Mapping250K_Nsp,monocell
Dimension: 1001x1001
Number of cells: 1002001
Number of units: 262338
Cells per unit: 3.82

Compare my output with ours. See if the file sizes match etc. If you
get an error on the way, please report traceback(). Also, try with
the 'Mapping250K_Sty' chip type to rule out a problem specific to a
single CDF.

/Henrik

Hello.
While trying to run the rutine found for the 500K in the
aroma.affymetrix google group web page, I encountered a problem. While
running the instruction

treatNAsAs: chr "weights"; mergeStrands: logi TRUE; combineAlleles: logi

chip type...

20080311 11:57:28| Chip type: Mapping250K_Nsp
20080311 11:57:28| Output pathname (temporary):
annotationData/chipTypes/Mapping250K_Nsp/Mapping250K_Nsp,monocell.CDF.tmp

Aborted
------------------
Does anybody know where the problem could be?

Thank you,
Valeria
